filters_override.description: Object (or pre-encoded JSON string) to override dashboard filters for this request only (not persisted). Top-level keys replace; nested values are not deep-merged — pass the complete value for any key you override. Accepts the same keys as the dashboard filters schema (e.g., `date_from`, `date_to`, `properties`). Ignored when accessed via a sharing token.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this dashboard.

refresh.description: Recompute widgets that follow dashboard filters (such as metrics) instead of serving their query cache, as a manual refresh of an insight tile does.

tile_ids.description: Comma-separated dashboard tile IDs to run widgets for.
